headline: Confirmation entries (CONFIRM) fail: paying for the move costs more than the selection gains. No live setup earns on both up and down days - the book is a stack of market-direction bets.
bullets: CONFIRM: entering only after price moves your way loses vs a plain market entry in all 10 setups (t -18 / -15).
Its apparent 'selector' is the first 10 minutes of the trade itself - path continuity, not foresight.
BOTHDAYS: of 74 live setups, none stays positive on both SPY-up and SPY-down days without its best day; longs gain ~+0.15R and shorts lose ~0.13R per 1% SPY move.
Hedging the market out leaves intercepts at chance (1 of 74 with t >= 2), so hedging won't rescue the book either.
Today: FAMC's first forward session; a minute-10 exit check (measurement only); one direction pilot.
next: Builder measures post-minute-10 drift; Scout's sector-split pilot; FAMC nightly after the close.
